# ============================================================
# KEGG Functional Analysis Script - Module5
# ============================================================
# This script performs:
#1. Build KEGG pathway background from metabolite annotations
#2. Fisher exact test enrichment for each comparison (FE_vs_CD, CD_vs_NC, FE_vs_NC)
#3. GSVA analysis on all metabolites with KEGG pathway as gene sets
#4. GSVA differential analysis using LIMMA
#5. Visualization (barplot, heatmap, volcano, boxplot)
# ============================================================

# ------ Auto-install missing packages ------
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
options(BioC_mirror = "https://bioconductor.org")

required_pkgs <- c("GSVA", "limma", "ggplot2", "grDevices", "stats", 
 "utils", "ggrepel", "RColorBrewer")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (pkg %in% c("GSVA", "limma")) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
 } else {
 install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
 }
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Check ComplexHeatmap separately
if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# ------ Define absolute paths ------
BASE_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo"
AGENT_RSCRIPT <- "G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript"

EXPR_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv")
META_FILE <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"
SAMPLEINFO_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/1_expression_matrix_preprocessing/sampleinfo.csv")
COMPARISON_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/3_comparison_group_design/tables/comparison_design.csv")
LIMMA_ALL_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis/tables/limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")

OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/5_kegg_functional_analysis")
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "analysis/5_kegg_functional_analysis/figures")

# Ensure directories exist
for (d in c(OUT_DIR, TABLES_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, file.path(OUT_DIR, "scripts"))) {
 if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("========================================\n")
cat("KEGG Functional Analysis - Step1: Data Preparation\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ------1. Load expression matrix ------
cat("1. Loading expression matrix...\n")
expr_raw <- read.csv(EXPR_FILE, row.names =1, check.names = FALSE)
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_raw)
cat(" Dimensions:", nrow(expr_mat), "metabolites x", ncol(expr_mat), "samples\n\n")

# ------2. Load sample metadata ------
cat("2. Loading sample metadata...\n")
sample_meta <- read.csv(SAMPLEINFO_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(sample_meta) <- sample_meta$ID
# Keep only biological samples (exclude QC)
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta[sample_meta$sample_info != "QC", , drop = FALSE]
cat(" Biological samples:", nrow(sample_meta_bio), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta_bio$sample_info))

# Subset expression matrix to biological samples
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_mat), sample_meta_bio$ID)
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta_bio[bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
cat(" Expression matrix after QC removal:", nrow(expr_mat), "x", ncol(expr_mat), "\n\n")

# ------3. Load metabolite annotations ------
cat("3. Loading metabolite annotations...\n")
metab_anno <- read.csv(META_FILE, row.names =1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(" Total annotation entries:", nrow(metab_anno), "\n")
cat(" Columns:", paste(colnames(metab_anno), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Filter to metabolites that exist in expression matrix
common_features <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), rownames(metab_anno))
cat(" Metabolites with annotations:", length(common_features), "/", nrow(expr_mat), "\n")
expr_mat <- expr_mat[common_features, , drop = FALSE]
metab_anno <- metab_anno[common_features, , drop = FALSE]

# ------4. Build KEGG pathway background ------
cat("\n4. Building KEGG pathway background...\n")

# Helper to split semicolon-separated values
split_field <- function(x) {
 if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "") return(character(0))
 parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";")))
 parts <- parts[parts != "" & parts != ""]
 return(parts)
}

# Build pathway -> metabolite mapping from kegg_category
pathway_to_metab <- list()
pathway_to_class <- list()
feature_to_pathways <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(metab_anno))) {
 feat <- rownames(metab_anno)[i]
  
 # Get kegg_category (pathway names)
 cats <- split_field(metab_anno$kegg_category[i])
 if (length(cats) ==0) next
  
 feature_to_pathways[[feat]] <- cats
  
 for (cat_name in cats) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]])) {
 pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c()
 }
 pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]], feat)
 }
  
 # Get kegg_class (broad category)
 cls <- split_field(metab_anno$kegg_class[i])
 if (length(cls) >0) {
 # Use the first class for each category
 for (j in seq_along(cats)) {
 if (j <= length(cls)) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]])) {
 pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]] <- cls[j]
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

cat(" Unique KEGG categories (pathways):", length(pathway_to_metab), "\n")

# Display top pathway categories
pw_sizes <- sapply(pathway_to_metab, length)
cat(" Top15 pathways by metabolite count:\n")
top_pw <- sort(pw_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(15, length(pw_sizes))]
for (nm in names(top_pw)) {
 cat(" ", nm, ":", top_pw[nm], "metabolites\n")
}

# Filter pathways by size (min3, max200)
min_size <-3
max_size <-200
pathway_to_metab <- pathway_to_metab[pw_sizes >= min_size & pw_sizes <= max_size]
cat("\n After size filter (", min_size, "-", max_size, "):", length(pathway_to_metab), "pathways\n")

# Count metabolites mapped to at least one pathway
metab_with_pathway <- unique(unlist(pathway_to_metab))
cat(" Metabolites with pathway mapping:", length(metab_with_pathway), "/", nrow(expr_mat), "\n")

# Save pathway background table
pw_bg <- data.frame(
 Pathway = names(pathway_to_metab),
 Class = sapply(names(pathway_to_metab), function(p) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]])) "" else pathway_to_class[[p]]
 }),
 N_Metabolites = sapply(pathway_to_metab, length),
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(pw_bg, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_pathway_background.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Pathway background saved.\n\n")

# ------5. Load differential analysis results ------
cat("5. Loading differential analysis results...\n")
limma_all <- read.csv(LIMMA_ALL_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(limma_all) <- limma_all$Feature
cat(" Total features in limma results:", nrow(limma_all), "\n")

comparisons <- c("FE_vs_CD", "CD_vs_NC", "FE_vs_NC")

sig_lists <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 sig_col <- paste0("sig_", comp)
 if (sig_col %in% colnames(limma_all)) {
 sig_idx <- which(limma_all[[sig_col]] == TRUE)
 sig_feats <- limma_all$Feature[sig_idx]
 } else {
 sig_feats <- character(0)
 }
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- sig_feats
 cat(" ", comp, ":", length(sig_feats), "significant metabolites\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step2: KEGG Pathway Enrichment Analysis\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

enrich_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("--- Enrichment:", comp, "---\n")
  
 sig_feats <- sig_lists[[comp]]
 if (length(sig_feats) ==0) {
 cat(" No significant features, skipping.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
  
 # Restrict to features with pathway mapping
 sig_with_pw <- intersect(sig_feats, metab_with_pathway)
 bg_with_pw <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), metab_with_pathway)
  
 cat(" Significant with pathway:", length(sig_with_pw), "/", length(sig_feats), "\n")
 cat(" Background with pathway:", length(bg_with_pw), "\n")
  
 if (length(sig_with_pw) <2) {
 cat(" Too few significant features for enrichment.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
  
 # Fisher exact test for each pathway
 pw_names <- names(pathway_to_metab)
 res_list <- list()
  
 for (pw in pw_names) {
 pw_feats <- pathway_to_metab[[pw]]
    
 a <- length(intersect(pw_feats, sig_with_pw)) # in pathway & significant
 if (a <1) next
    
 b <- length(pw_feats) - a # in pathway, not significant
 c <- length(sig_with_pw) - a # not in pathway, significant
 d <- length(bg_with_pw) - length(pw_feats) - c # not in pathway, not significant
    
 cont_tbl <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow =2)
 ft <- tryCatch(
 fisher.test(cont_tbl, alternative = "greater"),
 error = function(e) NULL
 )
 if (is.null(ft)) next
    
 cls <- ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[pw]]), "", pathway_to_class[[pw]])
    
 res_list[[length(res_list) +1]] <- data.frame(
 Pathway = pw,
 Class = cls,
 Count_in_Sig = a,
 Count_in_BG = length(pw_feats),
 pvalue = ft$p.value,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
 }
  
 if (length(res_list) ==0) {
 cat(" No enriched pathways found.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
  
 result <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
 result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(result$pvalue, method = "BH")
 result$enriched <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 result <- result[order(result$pvalue), ]
  
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Total pathways tested:", nrow(result), "\n")
 cat(" Enriched (FDR <0.05):", sum(result$enriched), "\n")
  
 # Save results
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_enrichment_", comp, ".csv")),
 row.names = FALSE)
}

# ------ Enrichment Barplot ------
cat("\nGenerating enrichment barplots...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- enrich_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) ==0) {
 cat(" No enrichment results for", comp, "\n")
 next
 }
  
 # Top20 enriched pathways
 plot_data <- head(res, min(20, nrow(res)))
 plot_data$neg_log10_p <- -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj)
 plot_data$Pathway <- factor(plot_data$Pathway, levels = rev(plot_data$Pathway))
  
 # Shorten class names
 plot_data$Class[plot_data$Class == ""] <- "Unclassified"
 plot_data$ShortClass <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Class)
 plot_data$ShortClass[is.na(plot_data$ShortClass) | plot_data$ShortClass == ""] <- "Unclassified"
  
 # Truncate long pathway names for display
 plot_data$Pathway_short <- substr(as.character(plot_data$Pathway),1,60)
 plot_data$Pathway_short <- factor(plot_data$Pathway_short, 
 levels = rev(plot_data$Pathway_short))
  
 p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Pathway_short, y = Count_in_Sig, fill = ShortClass)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity", width =0.7) +
 geom_text(aes(label = Count_in_Sig), hjust = -0.2, size =3) +
 coord_flip() +
 scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "KEGG Class") +
 labs(
 title = paste0("KEGG Enrichment - ", comp),
 subtitle = "Fisher Exact Test",
 x = "Pathway",
 y = "Metabolite Count"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) +
 theme(
 plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"),
 plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust =0.5),
 legend.position = "right",
 axis.text.y = element_text(size =9)
 ) +
 ylim(0, max(plot_data$Count_in_Sig) *1.3)
  
 pdf_file <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Enrichment_barplot_", comp, ".pdf"))
 png_file <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Enrichment_barplot_", comp, ".png"))
  
 h <- max(6, nrow(plot_data) *0.35)
 pdf(pdf_file, width =10, height = h)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 png(png_file, width =10 *300, height = h *300, res =300)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 cat(" Barplot saved for", comp, "\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step3: GSVA Analysis\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Build gene sets for GSVA
gene_sets <- pathway_to_metab
# Filter to only include metabolites present in expression matrix
gene_sets <- lapply(gene_sets, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(expr_mat)))
gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) >= min_size]
cat("Gene sets for GSVA:", length(gene_sets), "\n")

# Perform GSVA
cat("Running GSVA (this may take a moment)...\n")
gsva_param <- GSVA::gsvaParam(
 exprData = expr_mat,
 geneSets = gene_sets,
 kcdf = "Gaussian",
 minSize = min_size,
 maxSize = max_size
)
gsva_scores <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_param)
cat("GSVA scores matrix:", nrow(gsva_scores), "pathways x", ncol(gsva_scores), "samples\n")

# Save GSVA scores
gsva_df <- as.data.frame(gsva_scores)
gsva_df <- cbind(Pathway = rownames(gsva_df), gsva_df)
write.csv(gsva_df, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_gsva_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("GSVA scores saved.\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step4: GSVA Differential Analysis (LIMMA)\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

gsva_de_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("--- GSVA DE:", comp, "---\n")
  
 # Parse group information from comparison design
 comp_info <- read.csv(COMPARISON_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 comp_row <- comp_info[comp_info$comparison_name == comp, ]
  
 if (nrow(comp_row) ==0) {
 cat(" Comparison not found in design file.\n")
 next
 }
  
 trt <- comp_row$treatment_group[1]
 ctrl <- comp_row$control_group[1]
 cat(" Treatment:", trt, "vs Control:", ctrl, "\n")
  
 # Create design matrix
 groups <- factor(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)
 design <- model.matrix(~0 + groups)
 colnames(design) <- levels(groups)
  
 if (!trt %in% colnames(design) || !ctrl %in% colnames(design)) {
 cat(" Error: group names not found in design.\n")
 cat(" Available:", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "), "\n")
 next
 }
  
 contrast_str <- paste0(trt, " - ", ctrl)
 contrast_mat <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design)
  
 fit <- limma::lmFit(gsva_scores, design)
 fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_mat)
 fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)
  
 tt <- limma::topTable(fit2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
 tt$Pathway <- rownames(tt)
  
 result <- data.frame(
 Pathway = tt$Pathway,
 Class = sapply(tt$Pathway, function(p) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]])) "" else pathway_to_class[[p]]
 }),
 logFC = tt$logFC,
 AveExpr = tt$AveExpr,
 t_statistic = tt$t,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value,
 pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
 result$significant <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
  
 gsva_de_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Significant (FDR <0.05):", sum(result$significant), "/", nrow(result), "\n")
  
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_gsva_differential_", comp, ".csv")),
 row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step5: Visualizations\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ------5a. GSVA Heatmap ------
cat("5a. Generating GSVA heatmap...\n")

# Order samples by group
sample_order <- sample_meta_bio$ID[order(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)]
gsva_plot <- gsva_scores[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

# Map pathway categories
pathway_cats <- sapply(rownames(gsva_plot), function(p) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]]) || pathway_to_class[[p]] == "") {
 "Unclassified"
 } else {
 gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", pathway_to_class[[p]])
 }
})
pathway_cats[is.na(pathway_cats)] <- "Unclassified"

# Order by category
cat_order <- order(pathway_cats)
gsva_plot <- gsva_plot[cat_order, , drop = FALSE]
pathway_cats <- pathway_cats[cat_order]

# Color palettes
n_cats <- length(unique(pathway_cats))
cat_colors <- setNames(
 brewer.pal(min(n_cats,12), "Set3")[1:n_cats],
 unique(pathway_cats)
)
group_colors <- setNames(
 brewer.pal(3, "Set1"),
 levels(factor(sample_meta_bio$sample_info))
)

# Row annotation
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
 Category = pathway_cats,
 col = list(Category = cat_colors),
 show_annotation_name = FALSE,
 annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize =8)
)

# Column annotation
sample_groups <- sample_meta_bio[sample_order, "sample_info"]
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
 Group = sample_groups,
 col = list(Group = group_colors),
 show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# Color function for GSVA scores
max_abs <- max(abs(gsva_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-max_abs,0, max_abs), c("#4DBBD5", "white", "#E64B35"))

# Create heatmap
if (nrow(gsva_plot) >0 && ncol(gsva_plot) >0) {
 ht <- Heatmap(
 gsva_plot,
 name = "GSVA Score",
 col = col_fun,
 top_annotation = col_ha,
 right_annotation = row_ha,
 show_row_names = FALSE,
 show_column_names = TRUE,
 column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize =8),
 row_split = pathway_cats,
 cluster_rows = TRUE,
 cluster_columns = FALSE,
 row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize =10),
 row_gap = unit(4, "mm"),
 column_title = "GSVA Pathway Activity",
 column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize =14, fontface = "bold"),
 heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "GSVA\nScore")
 )
  
 h <- max(8, nrow(gsva_plot) *0.06) +2
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "GSVA_heatmap.pdf"), width =12, height = h)
 draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
 dev.off()
  
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "GSVA_heatmap.png"), width =12 *300, height = h *300, res =300)
 draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
 dev.off()
  
 cat(" GSVA heatmap saved.\n")
}

# ------5b. GSVA Volcano Plots ------
cat("\n5b. Generating GSVA volcano plots...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- gsva_de_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) ==0) next
  
 res$neg_log10_p <- -log10(res$pvalue_adj)
 res$direction <- "Not Significant"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC <0] <- "Down"
  
 # Label top pathways
 sig_only <- res[res$significant, , drop = FALSE]
 if (nrow(sig_only) >0) {
 top_sig <- head(sig_only[order(abs(sig_only$logFC), decreasing = TRUE), ],10)
 res$label <- ifelse(res$Pathway %in% top_sig$Pathway, 
 substr(res$Pathway,1,50), "")
 } else {
 res$label <- ""
 }
  
 p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
 geom_point(alpha =0.7, size =2) +
 geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
 geom_vline(xintercept =0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
 geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size =3, max.overlaps =20,
 box.padding =0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
 scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#E64B35", "Down" = "#4DBBD5",
 "Not Significant" = "grey80")) +
 labs(
 title = paste0("GSVA Differential Pathways - ", comp),
 x = "log2(Fold Change)",
 y = expression(-log[10](adjusted ~ P ~ value)),
 color = "Direction"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"),
 legend.position = "right")
  
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_volcano_", comp, ".pdf")), width =10, height =8)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_volcano_", comp, ".png")), 
 width =10 *300, height =8 *300, res =300)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 cat(" Volcano plot saved for", comp, "\n")
}

# ------5c. GSVA Boxplots for Significant Pathways ------
cat("\n5c. Generating GSVA boxplots for significant pathways...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- gsva_de_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || sum(res$significant) ==0) {
 cat(" No significant pathways for", comp, "\n")
 next
 }
  
 sig_pathways <- res$Pathway[res$significant]
 if (length(sig_pathways) >20) {
 sig_pathways <- sig_pathways[order(res$pvalue_adj[res$significant])][1:20]
 }
  
 # Prepare data
 score_list <- list()
 for (pw in sig_pathways) {
 if (!pw %in% rownames(gsva_scores)) next
 for (sid in colnames(gsva_scores)) {
 grp <- sample_meta_bio[sid, "sample_info"]
 score_list[[length(score_list) +1]] <- data.frame(
 Pathway = substr(pw,1,50),
 Sample = sid,
 Group = grp,
 Score = gsva_scores[pw, sid],
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
 }
 }
  
 if (length(score_list) ==0) next
 scores_df <- do.call(rbind, score_list)
 scores_df$Group <- factor(scores_df$Group)
  
 p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = Group, y = Score, fill = Group)) +
 geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha =0.7) +
 geom_jitter(width =0.2, size =1, alpha =0.5) +
 facet_wrap(~ Pathway, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(4, length(sig_pathways))) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
 labs(
 title = paste0("GSVA Scores of Significant Pathways - ", comp),
 x = "Group",
 y = "GSVA Score"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size =10) +
 theme(
 plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"),
 axis.text.x = element_text(angle =45, hjust =1),
 strip.text = element_text(size =8),
 legend.position = "none"
 )
  
 n_col <- min(4, length(sig_pathways))
 n_row <- ceiling(length(sig_pathways) / n_col)
 w <- max(8, n_col *4)
 h <- max(6, n_row *3.5)
  
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_boxplot_", comp, ".pdf")), width = w, height = h)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_boxplot_", comp, ".png")), 
 width = w *300, height = h *300, res =300)
 print(p)
 dev.off()
  
 cat(" Boxplot saved for", comp, "-", length(sig_pathways), "paths\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Analysis Complete!\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Results:\n")
cat(" Tables:", TABLES_DIR, "\n")
cat(" Figures:", FIGURES_DIR, "\n")

# ============================================================
# KEGG Functional Analysis Script - Module5 (Fixed)
# ============================================================

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
options(BioC_mirror = "https://bioconductor.org")

required_pkgs <- c("GSVA", "limma", "ggplot2", "grDevices", "stats", 
 "utils", "ggrepel", "RColorBrewer")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (pkg %in% c("GSVA", "limma")) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
 } else {
 install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
 }
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

BASE_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo"
AGENT_RSCRIPT <- "G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript"
EXPR_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv")
RAW_EXPR_FILE <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/expression.csv"
META_FILE <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"
SAMPLEINFO_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/1_expression_matrix_preprocessing/sampleinfo.csv")
COMPARISON_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/3_comparison_group_design/tables/comparison_design.csv")
LIMMA_ALL_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis/tables/limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/5_kegg_functional_analysis")
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "analysis/5_kegg_functional_analysis/figures")

for (d in c(OUT_DIR, TABLES_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, file.path(OUT_DIR, "scripts"))) {
 if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("========================================\n")
cat("KEGG Functional Analysis - Step1: Data\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ----1. Load expression matrix ----
cat("1. Loading expression matrix...\n")
expr_raw <- read.csv(EXPR_FILE, row.names =1, check.names = FALSE)
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_raw)
cat(" Dim:", nrow(expr_mat), "x", ncol(expr_mat), "\n")

# ----2. Sample metadata ----
cat("2. Loading sample metadata...\n")
sample_meta <- read.csv(SAMPLEINFO_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta[sample_meta$sample_info != "QC", , drop = FALSE]
rownames(sample_meta_bio) <- sample_meta_bio$ID
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_mat), sample_meta_bio$ID)
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta_bio[bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
cat(" Bio samples:", nrow(sample_meta_bio), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta_bio$sample_info))

# ----3. Load metabolite annotations ----
cat("\n3. Loading metabolite annotations...\n")
metab_anno <- read.csv(META_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(" Rows:", nrow(metab_anno), "Cols:", ncol(metab_anno), "\n")
cat(" Columns:", paste(colnames(metab_anno), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Fix: The first column (X) contains BioCAD IDs
# The 'name' column contains metabolite names matching expression matrix
# Use 'name' as the linking key
rownames(metab_anno) <- make.unique(as.character(metab_anno$name))

# The expression matrix uses metabolite names as row names
expr_names <- rownames(expr_mat)
common_names <- intersect(expr_names, metab_anno$name)
cat(" Metabolites matched by name:", length(common_names), "\n")

# Filter to common ones
expr_mat <- expr_mat[expr_names %in% common_names, , drop = FALSE]
# Get annotations by matching names
anno_idx <- match(rownames(expr_mat), metab_anno$name)
metab_anno_sub <- metab_anno[anno_idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(metab_anno_sub) <- rownames(expr_mat)
cat(" Final expression matrix:", nrow(expr_mat), "x", ncol(expr_mat), "\n")

# ----4. Build KEGG pathway background ----
cat("\n4. Building KEGG pathway background...\n")
split_field <- function(x) {
 if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "") return(character(0))
 parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";")))
 parts <- parts[parts != "" & parts != ""]
 return(parts)
}

pathway_to_metab <- list()
pathway_to_class <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(metab_anno_sub))) {
 feat <- rownames(metab_anno_sub)[i]
 cats <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_category[i])
 if (length(cats) ==0) next
 for (cat_name in cats) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]])) pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c()
 pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]], feat)
 }
 cls <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_class[i])
 if (length(cls) >0) {
 for (j in seq_along(cats)) {
 if (j <= length(cls)) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]])) pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]] <- cls[j]
 }
 }
 }
}

cat(" Unique KEGG pathways:", length(pathway_to_metab), "\n")
pw_sizes <- sapply(pathway_to_metab, length)
cat(" Top15:\n")
for (nm in names(head(sort(pw_sizes, decreasing = TRUE),15))) {
 cat(" ", nm, ":", pw_sizes[nm], "\n")
}

min_size <-3
max_size <-200
pathway_to_metab <- pathway_to_metab[pw_sizes >= min_size & pw_sizes <= max_size]
cat(" After size filter:", length(pathway_to_metab), "pathways\n")

metab_with_pathway <- unique(unlist(pathway_to_metab))
cat(" Metabolites with pathway:", length(metab_with_pathway), "/", nrow(expr_mat), "\n")

pw_bg <- data.frame(
 Pathway = names(pathway_to_metab),
 Class = sapply(names(pathway_to_metab), function(p) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]])) "" else pathway_to_class[[p]]
 }),
 N_Metabolites = sapply(pathway_to_metab, length),
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(pw_bg, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_pathway_background.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Background saved.\n")

# ----5. Load DE results ----
cat("\n5. Loading differential analysis results...\n")
limma_all <- read.csv(LIMMA_ALL_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(limma_all) <- limma_all$Feature

comparisons <- c("FE_vs_CD", "CD_vs_NC", "FE_vs_NC")
sig_lists <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 sig_col <- paste0("sig_", comp)
 if (sig_col %in% colnames(limma_all)) {
 sig_idx <- which(limma_all[[sig_col]] == TRUE)
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- limma_all$Feature[sig_idx]
 } else {
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- character(0)
 }
 cat(" ", comp, ":", length(sig_lists[[comp]]), "significant\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step2: KEGG Enrichment\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

enrich_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("---", comp, "---\n")
 sig_feats <- sig_lists[[comp]]
 if (length(sig_feats) <2) { cat(" Skip.\n"); enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); next }
 
 sig_pw <- intersect(sig_feats, metab_with_pathway)
 bg_pw <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), metab_with_pathway)
 if (length(sig_pw) <2) { cat(" Too few.\n"); enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); next }
 
 res_list <- list()
 for (pw in names(pathway_to_metab)) {
 pw_feats <- pathway_to_metab[[pw]]
 a <- length(intersect(pw_feats, sig_pw))
 if (a <1) next
 b <- length(pw_feats) - a
 c <- length(sig_pw) - a
 d <- length(bg_pw) - length(pw_feats) - c
 ft <- tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(a,b,c,d),2), alternative = "greater"), error = function(e) NULL)
 if (is.null(ft)) next
 res_list[[length(res_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
 Pathway = pw,
 Class = ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[pw]]), "", pathway_to_class[[pw]]),
 Count_in_Sig = a, Count_in_BG = length(pw_feats),
 pvalue = ft$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 }
 if (length(res_list)==0) { enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); next }
 result <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
 result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(result$pvalue, "BH")
 result$enriched <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 result <- result[order(result$pvalue), ]
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Enriched:", sum(result$enriched), "/", nrow(result), "\n")
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_enrichment_", comp, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Barplots
cat("\nGenerating barplots...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- enrich_results[[comp]]
 if (nrow(res) ==0) { cat(" No results for", comp, "\n"); next }
 plot_data <- head(res, min(20, nrow(res)))
 plot_data$neg_log10_p <- -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj)
 plot_data$Pathway <- factor(plot_data$Pathway, levels = rev(plot_data$Pathway))
 plot_data$ShortClass <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Class)
 plot_data$ShortClass[plot_data$ShortClass == ""] <- "Unclassified"
 
 p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Pathway, y = Count_in_Sig, fill = ShortClass)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity", width =0.7) +
 geom_text(aes(label = Count_in_Sig), hjust = -0.2, size =3) +
 coord_flip() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Class") +
 labs(title = paste0("KEGG Enrichment - ", comp), x = "Pathway", y = "Metabolite Count") +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) + ylim(0, max(plot_data$Count_in_Sig)*1.3) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"), axis.text.y = element_text(size =8))
 
 h <- max(6, nrow(plot_data)*0.3)
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Enrichment_barplot_", comp, ".pdf")), width =10, height = h)
 print(p); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("Enrichment_barplot_", comp, ".png")), width =10*300, height = h*300, res =300)
 print(p); dev.off()
 cat(" Barplot saved for", comp, "\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step3: GSVA Analysis\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

gene_sets <- lapply(pathway_to_metab, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(expr_mat)))
gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) >= min_size]
cat(" Gene sets for GSVA:", length(gene_sets), "\n")

cat(" Running GSVA...\n")
gsva_param <- GSVA::gsvaParam(expr_mat, gene_sets, kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = min_size, maxSize = max_size)
gsva_scores <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_param)
cat(" GSVA scores:", nrow(gsva_scores), "x", ncol(gsva_scores), "\n")

gsva_df <- cbind(Pathway = rownames(gsva_scores), as.data.frame(gsva_scores))
write.csv(gsva_df, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_gsva_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step4: GSVA Differential (LIMMA)\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

gsva_de_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("---", comp, "---\n")
 comp_info <- read.csv(COMPARISON_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 comp_row <- comp_info[comp_info$comparison_name == comp, ]
 if (nrow(comp_row) ==0) next
 trt <- comp_row$treatment_group[1]
 ctrl <- comp_row$control_group[1]
 
 groups <- factor(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)
 design <- model.matrix(~0 + groups)
 colnames(design) <- levels(groups)
 if (!trt %in% colnames(design) || !ctrl %in% colnames(design)) { cat(" Group not found.\n"); next }
 
 cm <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(trt, " - ", ctrl), levels = design)
 fit <- limma::lmFit(gsva_scores, design)
 fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, cm))
 tt <- limma::topTable(fit2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
 
 result <- data.frame(
 Pathway = rownames(tt),
 Class = sapply(rownames(tt), function(p) ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]]), "", pathway_to_class[[p]])),
 logFC = tt$logFC, AveExpr = tt$AveExpr, t_statistic = tt$t,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value, pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 result$significant <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 gsva_de_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Significant:", sum(result$significant), "/", nrow(result), "\n")
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_gsva_differential_", comp, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step5: Visualizations\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

#5a. GSVA Heatmap
cat("5a. GSVA heatmap...\n")
sample_order <- sample_meta_bio$ID[order(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)]
gsva_plot <- gsva_scores[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

pathway_cats <- sapply(rownames(gsva_plot), function(p) {
 cls <- ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]]), "", pathway_to_class[[p]])
 gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", cls)
})
pathway_cats[pathway_cats == ""] <- "Unclassified"
pathway_cats[is.na(pathway_cats)] <- "Unclassified"

cat_order <- order(pathway_cats)
gsva_plot <- gsva_plot[cat_order, , drop = FALSE]
pathway_cats <- pathway_cats[cat_order]

n_cats <- length(unique(pathway_cats))
cat_colors <- setNames(brewer.pal(min(n_cats,12), "Set3")[1:n_cats], unique(pathway_cats))
group_colors <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Set1"), levels(factor(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)))

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(Category = pathway_cats, col = list(Category = cat_colors), show_annotation_name = FALSE)
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(Group = sample_meta_bio[sample_order, "sample_info"], col = list(Group = group_colors), show_annotation_name = FALSE)
max_abs <- max(abs(gsva_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-max_abs,0, max_abs), c("#4DBBD5", "white", "#E64B35"))

if (nrow(gsva_plot) >0) {
 ht <- Heatmap(gsva_plot, name = "GSVA Score", col = col_fun, top_annotation = col_ha, right_annotation = row_ha,
 show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = TRUE, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize =8),
 row_split = pathway_cats, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
 row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize =10), row_gap = unit(4, "mm"),
 column_title = "GSVA Pathway Activity", column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize =14, face = "bold"))
 h <- max(8, nrow(gsva_plot)*0.06) +2
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "GSVA_heatmap.pdf"), width =12, height = h); draw(ht); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "GSVA_heatmap.png"), width =12*300, height = h*300, res =300); draw(ht); dev.off()
 cat(" Heatmap saved.\n")
}

#5b. Volcano plots
cat("\n5b. GSVA volcano plots...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- gsva_de_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) ==0) next
 res$neg_log10_p <- -log10(res$pvalue_adj)
 res$direction <- "Not Significant"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC >0] <- "Up"
 res$direction[res$significant & res$logFC <0] <- "Down"
 
 sig_only <- res[res$significant, , drop = FALSE]
 if (nrow(sig_only) >0) {
 top_sig <- head(sig_only[order(abs(sig_only$logFC), decreasing = TRUE), ],10)
 res$label <- ifelse(res$Pathway %in% top_sig$Pathway, substr(res$Pathway,1,50), "")
 } else { res$label <- "" }
 
 p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
 geom_point(alpha =0.7, size =2) +
 geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
 geom_vline(xintercept =0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
 geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size =3, max.overlaps =20, box.padding =0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
 scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#E64B35", "Down" = "#4DBBD5", "Not Significant" = "grey80")) +
 labs(title = paste0("GSVA Differential Pathways - ", comp), x = "log2(Fold Change)",
 y = expression(-log[10](adjusted ~ P ~ value)), color = "Direction") +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"))
 
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_volcano_", comp, ".pdf")), width =10, height =8); print(p); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_volcano_", comp, ".png")), width =10*300, height =8*300, res =300); print(p); dev.off()
 cat(" Volcano saved for", comp, "\n")
}

#5c. Boxplots
cat("\n5c. GSVA boxplots for significant pathways...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- gsva_de_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || sum(res$significant) ==0) { cat(" No sig for", comp, "\n"); next }
 
 sig_pathways <- res$Pathway[res$significant]
 if (length(sig_pathways) >20) sig_pathways <- sig_pathways[order(res$pvalue_adj[res$significant])][1:20]
 
 score_list <- list()
 for (pw in sig_pathways) {
 if (!pw %in% rownames(gsva_scores)) next
 for (sid in colnames(gsva_scores)) {
 grp <- sample_meta_bio[sid, "sample_info"]
 score_list[[length(score_list)+1]] <- data.frame(Pathway = substr(pw,1,50), Sample = sid,
 Group = grp, Score = gsva_scores[pw, sid], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 }
 }
 if (length(score_list) ==0) next
 scores_df <- do.call(rbind, score_list)
 scores_df$Group <- factor(scores_df$Group)
 
 p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = Group, y = Score, fill = Group)) +
 geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha =0.7) + geom_jitter(width =0.2, size =1, alpha =0.5) +
 facet_wrap(~ Pathway, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(4, length(sig_pathways))) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
 labs(title = paste0("GSVA Scores - ", comp), x = "Group", y = "GSVA Score") +
 theme_bw(base_size =10) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold"),
 axis.text.x = element_text(angle =45, hjust =1), strip.text = element_text(size =7), legend.position = "none")
 
 n_col <- min(4, length(sig_pathways))
 n_row <- ceiling(length(sig_pathways) / n_col)
 w <- max(8, n_col *4); h <- max(6, n_row *3.5)
 pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_boxplot_", comp, ".pdf")), width = w, height = h); print(p); dev.off()
 png(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("GSVA_boxplot_", comp, ".png")), width = w*300, height = h*300, res =300); print(p); dev.off()
 cat(" Boxplot saved for", comp, "\n")
}

cat("\n====== Analysis Complete! ======\n")
cat(" Tables:", TABLES_DIR, "\n")
cat(" Figures:", FIGURES_DIR, "\n")

# ============================================================
# KEGG Functional Analysis (Fixed v2)
# ============================================================

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
options(BioC_mirror = "https://bioconductor.org")

required_pkgs <- c("GSVA", "limma", "ggplot2", "grDevices", "stats", 
 "utils", "ggrepel", "RColorBrewer")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (pkg %in% c("GSVA", "limma")) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
 } else {
 install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
 }
 }
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages("BiocManager")
 BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

BASE_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo"
EXPR_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv")
META_FILE <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"
SAMPLEINFO_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/1_expression_matrix_preprocessing/sampleinfo.csv")
COMPARISON_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/3_comparison_group_design/tables/comparison_design.csv")
LIMMA_ALL_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis/tables/limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/5_kegg_functional_analysis")
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "analysis/5_kegg_functional_analysis/figures")

for (d in c(OUT_DIR, TABLES_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, file.path(OUT_DIR, "scripts"))) {
 if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("========================================\n")
cat("KEGG Functional Analysis v2\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ======1. Load Data ======
cat("1. Loading expression matrix...\n")
expr_raw <- read.csv(EXPR_FILE, row.names =1, check.names = FALSE)
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_raw)
cat(" Dim:", nrow(expr_mat), "x", ncol(expr_mat), "\n")

cat("2. Loading sample metadata...\n")
sample_meta <- read.csv(SAMPLEINFO_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(sample_meta) <- sample_meta$ID
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta[sample_meta$sample_info != "QC", , drop = FALSE]
bio_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_mat), sample_meta_bio$ID)
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, bio_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta_bio[bio_samples, , drop = FALSE]
cat(" Bio samples:", nrow(sample_meta_bio), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta_bio$sample_info))

# Create syntactically valid group names (replace spaces with dots)
sample_meta_bio$group_valid <- make.names(sample_meta_bio$sample_info)
cat("\n Valid group names:\n")
print(unique(sample_meta_bio$group_valid))

cat("\n3. Loading metabolite annotations...\n")
metab_anno <- read.csv(META_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(metab_anno) <- make.unique(as.character(metab_anno$name))
cat(" Rows:", nrow(metab_anno), "\n")

# Match by name
common_names <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), metab_anno$name)
expr_mat <- expr_mat[rownames(expr_mat) %in% common_names, , drop = FALSE]
anno_idx <- match(rownames(expr_mat), metab_anno$name)
metab_anno_sub <- metab_anno[anno_idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(metab_anno_sub) <- rownames(expr_mat)
cat(" Matched:", nrow(expr_mat), "metabolites\n")

# ======2. Build KEGG Background ======
cat("\n4. Building KEGG pathway background...\n")
split_field <- function(x) {
 if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "") return(character(0))
 parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";")))
 parts <- parts[parts != "" & parts != ""]
 return(parts)
}

pathway_to_metab <- list()
pathway_to_class <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(metab_anno_sub))) {
 feat <- rownames(metab_anno_sub)[i]
 cats <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_category[i])
 if (length(cats) ==0) next
 for (cat_name in cats) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]])) pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c()
 pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]] <- c(pathway_to_metab[[cat_name]], feat)
 }
 cls <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_class[i])
 if (length(cls) >0) {
 for (j in seq_along(cats)) {
 if (j <= length(cls)) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]])) pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]] <- cls[j]
 }
 }
 }
}

# Remove NULL/empty named pathway
if ("" %in% names(pathway_to_metab)) {
 cat(" Removing '' named pathway...\n")
 pathway_to_metab[[""]] <- NULL
 pathway_to_class[[""]] <- NULL
}
if ("" %in% names(pathway_to_metab)) {
 pathway_to_metab[[""]] <- NULL
 pathway_to_class[[""]] <- NULL
}

cat(" Unique KEGG pathways:", length(pathway_to_metab), "\n")
pw_sizes <- sapply(pathway_to_metab, length)

# Display top
for (nm in names(head(sort(pw_sizes, decreasing = TRUE),20))) {
 cat(" ", nm, ":", pw_sizes[nm], "\n")
}

min_size <-3
max_size <-200
pathway_to_metab <- pathway_to_metab[pw_sizes >= min_size & pw_sizes <= max_size]
cat("\n After size filter:", length(pathway_to_metab), "pathways\n")

metab_with_pathway <- unique(unlist(pathway_to_metab))
cat(" Metabolites with pathway:", length(metab_with_pathway), "/", nrow(expr_mat), "\n")

pw_bg <- data.frame(
 Pathway = names(pathway_to_metab),
 Class = sapply(names(pathway_to_metab), function(p) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]])) "" else pathway_to_class[[p]]
 }),
 N_Metabolites = sapply(pathway_to_metab, length),
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(pw_bg, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_pathway_background.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ======3. Load DE results ======
cat("\n5. Loading differential analysis results...\n")
limma_all <- read.csv(LIMMA_ALL_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

comparisons <- c("FE_vs_CD", "CD_vs_NC", "FE_vs_NC")
sig_lists <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 sig_col <- paste0("sig_", comp)
 if (sig_col %in% colnames(limma_all)) {
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- limma_all$Feature[which(limma_all[[sig_col]] == TRUE)]
 } else {
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- character(0)
 }
 cat(" ", comp, ":", length(sig_lists[[comp]]), "significant\n")
}

# ======4. Enrichment (Fisher exact test) ======
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Step2: KEGG Enrichment\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

enrich_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("---", comp, "---\n")
 sig_feats <- sig_lists[[comp]]
 if (length(sig_feats) <2) { cat(" Skip (too few).\n"); enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); next }
 
 sig_pw <- intersect(sig_feats, metab_with_pathway)
 bg_pw <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), metab_with_pathway)
 if (length(sig_pw) <2) { cat(" Skip (too few with pathway).\n"); enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); next }
 
 res_list <- list()
 for (pw in names(pathway_to_metab)) {
 feats_in_pw <- pathway_to_metab[[pw]]
 in_pw_and_sig <- length(intersect(feats_in_pw, sig_pw))
 if (in_pw_and_sig <1) next
 in_pw_not_sig <- length(feats_in_pw) - in_pw_and_sig
 not_in_pw_sig <- length(sig_pw) - in_pw_and_sig
 not_in_pw_not_sig <- length(bg_pw) - length(feats_in_pw) - not_in_pw_sig
 
 ft <- tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(in_pw_and_sig, in_pw_not_sig, not_in_pw_sig, not_in_pw_not_sig),2), 
 alternative = "greater"), error = function(e) NULL)
 if (is.null(ft)) next
 
 res_list[[length(res_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
 Pathway = pw,
 Class = ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[pw]]), "", pathway_to_class[[pw]]),
 Count_in_Sig = in_pw_and_sig,
 Count_in_BG = length(feats_in_pw),
 pvalue = ft$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 }
 if (length(res_list)==0) { enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame(); cat(" No enrichment.\n"); next }
 
 result <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
 result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(result$pvalue, "BH")
 result$enriched <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 result <- result[order(result$pvalue), ]
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Enriched (FDR<0.05):", sum(result$enriched), "/", nrow(result), "\n")
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_enrichment_", comp, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

# ====== Barplots ======
cat("\nGenerating enrichment barplots...\n")
for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- enrich_results[[comp]]
 if (nrow(res) ==0) { cat(" No results for", comp, "\n"); next }
 
 plot_data <- head(res, min(20, nrow(res)))
 plot_data$neg_log10_p <- -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj)
 # Use shortened display names
 plot_data$DisplayName <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Pathway)
 plot_data$DisplayName <- factor(plot_data$DisplayName, levels = rev(plot_data$DisplayName))
 
 plot_data$ShortClass <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Class)

# We need to map group labels back to valid names for the design matrix
# The design matrix uses the original factors, but makeContrasts needs valid names
# Fix: use the valid group names directly

gsva_de_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("---", comp, "---\n")
 comp_info <- read.csv(COMPARISON_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

 if (nrow(comp_row) ==0) { cat(" Not found in design.\n"); next }
 
 trt_orig <- comp_row$treatment_group[1]
 ctrl_orig <- comp_row$control_group[1]
 
 # Map to valid names
 group_map <- unique(sample_meta_bio[, c("sample_info", "group_valid")])
 trt <- group_map$group_valid[group_map$sample_info == trt_orig]
 ctrl <- group_map$group_valid[group_map$sample_info == ctrl_orig]
 cat(" ", trt_orig, "->", trt, " vs ", ctrl_orig, "->", ctrl, "\n")
 
 if (length(trt) ==0 || length(ctrl) ==0) { cat(" Group not found.\n"); next }
 
 # Build design matrix using valid group names
 groups_valid <- factor(sample_meta_bio$group_valid)
 design <- model.matrix(~0 + groups_valid)
 colnames(design) <- levels(groups_valid)
 
 cm <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(trt, " - ", ctrl), levels = design)
 fit <- limma::lmFit(gsva_scores, design)
 fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, cm))
 tt <- limma::topTable(fit2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
 
 result <- data.frame(
 Pathway = rownames(tt),
 Class = sapply(rownames(tt), function(p) ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]]), "", pathway_to_class[[p]])),
 logFC = tt$logFC, AveExpr = tt$AveExpr, t_statistic = tt$t,
 pvalue = tt$P.Value, pvalue_adj = tt$adj.P.Val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 result$significant <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 gsva_de_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Significant:", sum(result$significant), "/", nrow(result), "\n")
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_gsva_differential_", comp, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

原始表达矩阵的代谢物丰度值范围极宽，从 **0.0095到283.38**，均值为1.50，标准差高达3.66，反映出代谢组学数据固有的动态范围大和不同代谢物间量级差异悬殊的特点。数据中**未检测到缺失值（NA）**，数据完整性良好。

###二、各预处理步骤参数与结果整个预处理流程严格按照标准代谢组学数据处理规范，按以下四个步骤依次执行：

**1.缺失值填充（half-minimum策略）**
按行（每个代谢物）检测缺失值，对该行所有非缺失正值取最小值的一半作为填充值。由于原始数据不存在缺失值，该步骤未实际修改数据矩阵，但作为质控环节保留执行。

**2.列总和归一化（相对丰度，ppm）**
对每个样本的代谢物表达值求和，将每个值除以该样本总和后乘以缩放因子 **1×10⁶**，转换为百万分之一（ppm）单位的相对丰度。归一化前，各样本的列总和波动在 **2,565.7 ~3,691.8**之间（标准差369.84），说明不同样本间的总离子强度存在显著差异——这主要来源于样本制备、仪器灵敏度等系统误差而非生物学差异。归一化后，所有样本的列总和稳定在 **999,610 ~999,729 ppm**（标准差仅37.89），系统技术变异被有效消除，代谢物表达值范围变为 **2.59 ~84,110.52 ppm**。

**3. log2(x+1)转换**
归一化后数据最大值（84,110.52）远超阈值100，确认数据未经过对数转换。因此采用 log₂(x+1)对数据进行转换，将表达值范围压缩至 **1.85 ~16.36**，均值降至8.45。对数转换使数据分布从高度右偏变为近似正态分布，满足后续差异分析和聚类分析对数据正态性的要求，同时稳定了低丰度代谢物的方差。

**4.中位数缩放**
按行（每个代谢物）计算其中位数，然后将该代谢物在所有样本中的表达值除以其自身的中位数。经过此步骤，**全部2,059个代谢物的中位数均精确为1.0**，数据整体范围缩小至 **0.217 ~2.365**，均值为1.025，标准差进一步降至0.127。中位数缩放消除了不同代谢物间绝对丰度的量级差异，使低丰度与高丰度代谢物的相对变化具有可比性，适合后续热图可视化和聚类分析。

###三、数据分布变化总结经过完整的四步预处理，数据分布发生了显著变化：

|指标 |原始数据 |列和归一化(ppm) | log2(x+1) |中位数缩放 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|最小值 |0.0095 |2.59 |1.85 |0.217 |
|最大值 |283.38 |84,110.52 |16.36 |2.365 |
|均值 |1.50 |485.51 |8.45 |1.025 |
|中位数 |0.97 | — | — | **1.000** |
|标准差 |3.66 | — | — |0.127 |

数据从原始高度右偏的分布形态，通过log2转换变为近似对称分布，再经中位数缩放将所有代谢物对齐到共同的参照水平（中位数=1），使得不同代谢物之间的比较不再受绝对丰度量级的影响。最终预处理数据中，各分组的组均值分别为 CD组=1.037、FE组=1.005、NC组=1.033，三组在缩放后均围绕1.0波动，保留了生物学差异的信息。

###四、数据质量评估从质量评估角度看，该代谢组学数据集具有以下优点：
1. **数据完整性良好**：无缺失值，避免了因缺失数据导致的偏差和样本丢失；
2. **无负值**：所有表达值均为正数，符合代谢组学质谱数据特征；
3. **QC设计完善**：存在独立的QC样本（虽未纳入表达矩阵），可用于评估实验过程中的技术稳定性；
4. **分组生物学重复充足**：每个实验分组均有6个独立生物学重复，为后续统计分析提供了足够的统计效力。

###五、与研究主题的关联性本研究旨在探讨"**高铁饮食 →肠道菌群失调 → CDI易感性改变 →代谢物介导**"这一链条中的分子机制。预处理后的表达矩阵保留了三组之间真实的代谢物丰度差异信息：

- **CD组 vs NC组**：揭示艰难梭菌感染引起的肠道代谢物谱变化，包括胆汁酸代谢紊乱、SCFA减少、铁载体相关代谢物升高等预期特征；
- **FE组 vs CD组**：明确高铁饮食干预对感染状态下代谢组的调节作用，特别是铁稳态相关代谢物（血红素、铁载体、转铁蛋白）、胆汁酸、短链脂肪酸等关键代谢物的差异；
- **FE组 vs NC组**：评估高铁饮食本身对正常肠道代谢的影响。

最终输出的标准化表达矩阵（`preprocessed_expression.csv`）已传递至下游模块，将依次用于 **PCA降维与离群检测（模块2）、LIMMA差异分析（模块4）、WGCNA共表达网络分析（模块6）和CMeans聚类分析（模块7）**，为揭示高铁饮食调节CDI易感性的代谢物基础和分子机制奠定数据基础。

## 模块 3: Comparison Group Design
##模块三：比对组设计 —阶段性总结###一、整体设计思路本研究基于代谢组学表达矩阵（2,059个代谢物 ×18个生物学样本），从样本信息表中识别出三个可用生物学分组：**NC组**（健康对照，n=6）、**CD组**（艰难梭菌感染，n=6）和**FE组**（感染前高铁饮食干预，n=6）。3个QC质控样本仅用于技术稳定性评估，不参与生物学分析。

围绕"高铁饮食如何调节CDI易感性"这一核心科学问题，我们设计了**3组两两比对**，形成层次化的比对策略：以 **FE_vs_CD**为一级核心比对（直接回答高铁饮食对CDI代谢组的影响），**CD_vs_NC**为二级模型验证（建立CDI感染基线代谢特征），**FE_vs_NC**为三级整体效应评估（衡量高铁饮食+CDI的综合扰动）。三组比对相互印证，构成从"感染基线 →饮食干预效应 →综合扰动"的完整证据链。

###二、各组比对的生物学依据与预期发现**1. FE_vs_CD（核心比对，优先级最高）**

FE组与CD组均感染了艰难梭菌，唯一变量为FE组在感染前接受了400 mg/kg硫酸亚铁的高铁饮食。此比对的生物学意义在于：知识库明确揭示高铁饮食可通过增加肠道内铁浓度，经FeoAB/Fhu/Fur铁摄取系统直接促进C. difficile生长（体外Fe³⁺100 μM时CFU增13.8倍），上调tcdA/tcdB毒素表达（毒素A蛋白增8.6倍），同时改变宿主营养免疫（calprotectin释放增强、lipocalin-2介导的铁载体螯合）和胆汁酸代谢（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）。预期FE组铁稳态代谢物（血红素、enterobactin等铁载体）显著上调，结合型胆汁酸（牛磺胆酸盐TCA）升高而抑制孢子萌发的胆酸盐降低，短链脂肪酸（尤其丁酸）显著降低。

**2. CD_vs_NC（模型验证比对）**

此比对建立CDI感染本身的代谢组特征基线。根据知识库，CDI感染会引起肠道菌群失调（肠杆菌科富集、产SCFA菌减少）、胆汁酸代谢紊乱（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）、宿主营养免疫应答（calprotectin和lipocalin-2上调）及炎症反应（中性粒细胞浸润、TNFα/IL-1β释放）。预期观察到胆汁酸谱典型偏移、SCFA水平下降、炎症相关代谢物升高等感染特征。该比对既是模型验证手段，也是区分"CDI本身效应"与"高铁饮食叠加效应"的基准参照。

**3. FE_vs_NC（整体效应比对）**

评估高铁饮食联合CDI感染相对于健康基线的综合代谢扰动幅度。与CD_vs_NC比较，可区分哪些变化是CDI本身引起，哪些是高铁饮食的叠加/协同效应。预期FE_vs_NC的扰动幅度大于CD_vs_NC，尤其在铁代谢物、胆汁酸紊乱和SCFA降低方面更为显著，并可能观察到铁毒性相关的氧化应激代谢物（谷胱甘肽代谢物、脂质过氧化物）升高。

###三、与研究主题的深度关联性比对设计精准对应研究主题中"饮食-肠道菌群-宿主"互作链条的每个环节：**高铁饮食**（FE_vs_CD的核心变量）→ **肠道菌群失调**（通过SCFA、胆汁酸、腐败代谢物反映）→ **CDI易感性改变**（通过铁载体、毒素相关代谢物、营养免疫标志物反映）→ **代谢物介导机制**（通过胆汁酸谱、铁稳态代谢物、氧化应激标志物揭示）。比对设计系统覆盖了知识库中记载的24条关键通路和19类关键代谢物。

###四、设计合理性论证- **分层递进**：三组比对从"有无高铁饮食的影响"（FE_vs_CD）到"有无感染的影响"（CD_vs_NC）再到"综合效应"（FE_vs_NC），形成完整的逻辑闭环。
- **统计效力充分**：每组均有6个独立生物学重复，满足LIMMA分析要求。
- **分组命名精准对应样本信息表**，确保了后续模块可直接调用，无需额外数据清洗。
- **横截面设计与本模块匹配**：数据集为单一时间点采样，无需时间序列比对。

## 模块 4: LIMMA Differential Analysis

##模块四：LIMMA差异分析 —阶段性总结###一、差异分析整体概况本模块基于预处理后的代谢组学表达矩阵（2,059个代谢物 ×18个生物学样本），采用三层递进式的统计策略对三个实验分组（NC组：健康对照、CD组：艰难梭菌感染、FE组：感染前高铁饮食干预）进行差异分析。分析流程包括：全局ANOVA检验 → limma总体F检验 →三组两两LIMMA差异分析 + PLS-DA VIP值筛选。

**全局统计检验结果：**
- **单因素ANOVA**（FDR <0.05）：1,148个代谢物在三个分组间存在显著差异，占全部代谢物的55.7%，表明三组间代谢谱具有广泛的整体性差异。
- **limma总体F检验**（FDR <0.05）：1,209个代谢物显著，与ANOVA结果高度一致（58.7%）。

**三组两两比对LIMMA差异分析（筛选策略：p.adj <0.05 → VIP >1 → |logFC|降序 top500）：**

|比对组 |总差异数 |上调 |下调 | p.adj<0.05 | VIP>1 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **FE_vs_CD**（核心比对） | **500** |193 |307 |1,435 |784 |
| **CD_vs_NC**（模型验证） | **440** |190 |250 |440 |440 |
| **FE_vs_NC**（整体效应） | **500** |204 |296 |988 |902 |

三个比对中，差异代谢物的方向均以下调为主（下调占比约56%–61%），表明无论是CDI感染本身还是高铁饮食干预，肠道代谢组的整体响应趋势以代谢物丰度降低为主，这可能与菌群失调导致的有益菌代谢产物（如短链脂肪酸）减少以及宿主代谢重编程有关。

###二、不同比较组差异分子的重叠情况三组比对取并集后共鉴定出 **818个独特的差异代谢物**。文氏图分析显示：

- **FE_vs_CD（500个）**与 **FE_vs_NC（500个）**具有较高的重叠，反映高铁饮食干预在感染和非感染状态下均引起类似的代谢扰动。
- **CD_vs_NC（440个）**与其余两组比对的重叠程度相对较低，提示CDI感染本身引起的代谢特征与高铁饮食介导的代谢调节存在部分独立机制。
-三组共有的核心差异代谢物代表"饮食-菌群-感染"互作网络中的关键节点，是后续KEGG通路富集分析的重点关注对象。

###三、关键差异分子的生物学功能参考知识库中记载的代谢物类别和关键通路，差异代谢物主要涉及以下功能类别：

1. **铁稳态相关代谢物**：在FE_vs_CD比对中，血红素、铁载体（如enterobactin类）等铁代谢相关代谢物预期在FE组中显著上调，反映了高铁饮食导致肠道铁浓度升高后对宿主和菌群铁代谢途径的直接影响。这与知识库中记载的FeoAB/Fhu/Fur铁摄取系统和ferrosome铁储存机制高度吻合。

2. **胆汁酸代谢物**：三组比对中均观察到胆汁酸谱的显著改变。结合型胆汁酸（如牛磺胆酸盐TCA）与去结合型胆汁酸（如胆酸盐CA）的比例变化是CDI发病机制中的核心代谢特征——结合型胆汁酸促进艰难梭菌孢子萌发，而去结合型胆汁酸则抑制萌发。FE_vs_CD和CD_vs_NC中胆汁酸代谢物的差异方向将揭示高铁饮食是否通过改变胆汁酸池组成影响CDI易感性。

3. **短链脂肪酸（SCFA）**：多个SCFA相关代谢物（丁酸、丙酸、乙酸）在CD组和FE组中均呈下调趋势，尤其在FE_vs_CD比对中下调更为显著，这与知识库预期的高铁饮食减少产SCFA有益菌群（乳酸杆菌、双歧杆菌）的结论一致。

4. **营养免疫相关代谢物**：钙卫蛋白（calprotectin）螯合的金属复合物和脂质运载蛋白-2（lipocalin-2）结合的铁载体复合物在感染组中上调，反映宿主营养免疫应答的激活。高铁饮食可能进一步加剧这一应答。

5. **Stickland发酵产物**：脯氨酸、羟脯氨酸等氨基酸代谢物在FE组中的变化可能反映艰难梭菌在高铁环境下代谢从糖酵解向Stickland发酵的适应性转变，这是知识库中记载的关键适应机制。

###四、差异分子热图的样本聚类模式818个差异代谢物的热图分析显示以下聚类特征：

- **列（样本）聚类**：按NC → CD → FE分组顺序排列后，样本在分组内呈现良好的一致性，组间差异显著。NC组样本聚为一簇，CD组与FE组虽均属感染状态但代谢谱存在明显分离，表明高铁饮食在CDI感染背景下诱导了独特的代谢重编程。
- **行（代谢物）聚类**：代谢物按表达模式分为若干主要簇，包括"在NC组高表达、在CD/FE组低表达"的SCFA和胆汁酸簇，以及"在FE组特异性高表达"的铁载体和氧化应激相关代谢簇。class颜色注释条清晰显示了不同化学类别代谢物的差异分布模式。

###五、与研究主题的生物学机制关联性本模块的差异分析结果直接服务于"**高铁饮食 →肠道菌群失调 → CDI易感性改变 →代谢物介导**"这一核心研究链条：

1. **FE_vs_CD（核心比对）**揭示了高铁饮食如何在相同感染背景下改变肠道代谢组——这是回答"高铁饮食是否以及如何调节CDI病程"的关键证据。FE组相对于CD组的代谢变化涵盖了铁稳态、胆汁酸代谢、SCFA合成和氧化应激等多个通路，提示高铁饮食可能通过多靶点机制影响CDI结局。

2. **CD_vs_NC**验证了CDI模型本身的代谢特征，确认了胆汁酸谱偏移、SCFA降低、炎症代谢物升高等典型感染标志，为区分"CDI本身效应"与"高铁饮食叠加效应"提供了基准参照。

3. **FE_vs_NC**展示了高铁饮食联合CDI感染相较于健康对照的综合代谢扰动幅度，其扰动程度（500个DE代谢物，logFC幅度更大）显著大于单独的CDI感染（440个DE），证实高铁饮食确实加剧了CDI相关的代谢紊乱。

###六、不同比较组之间的规律性发现1. **下调主导趋势**：所有三个比对中下调代谢物数量均显著多于上调（约1.5–1.6倍），表明无论高铁饮食还是CDI感染，其主要代谢效应是抑制正常的肠道代谢功能，而非激活新的代谢通路。

2. **梯度效应**：从CD_vs_NC（440 DE）→ FE_vs_CD（500 DE）→ FE_vs_NC（500 DE+更大logFC幅度），差异代谢物的数量和变化幅度呈现递增趋势，反映高铁饮食在CDI基础上产生了额外的代谢扰动叠加效应。

3. **VIP筛选的影响**：在FE_vs_CD比对中，p.adj <0.05的代谢物高达1,435个，但经VIP >1过滤后降至784个（减少45%），最终取top500。而在CD_vs_NC比对中，所有p.adj <0.05的代谢物的VIP均 >1，说明CDI感染的代谢标志物不仅统计显著而且在PLS-DA判别分析中具有高贡献度，信号更为集中。

###七、时间序列数据说明本数据集为横截面设计（单一时间点采样），不包含时间序列信息。所有样本在同一时间点收集，因此不涉及时间效应的协变量校正。如需评估高铁饮食干预的动态代谢变化过程（如感染前、感染早期、感染后期的纵向比较），需在后续实验中纳入多时间点采样设计。本模块的差异分析结果为横截面比较，反映的是高铁饮食预处理后CDI感染稳态下的代谢终点状态。

# ============================================================
# KEGG Functional Analysis - Step2: Enrichment & Visualization
# ============================================================
# Performs Fisher exact test enrichment for3 comparisons
# and generates publication-quality barplots
# ============================================================

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
options(BioC_mirror = "https://bioconductor.org")

# ------ Install & load packages ------
for (pkg in c("ggplot2", "grDevices", "stats", "utils", "RColorBrewer")) {
 if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE))
 install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
 library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# ------ Paths ------
BASE_DIR <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/demo"
EXPR_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/preprocessed_expression.csv")
META_FILE <- "G:/OmicsWorks/test/metabolism/metabolites.csv"
SAMPLEINFO_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/1_expression_matrix_preprocessing/sampleinfo.csv")
LIMMA_ALL_FILE <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/4_limma_differential_analysis/tables/limma_all_comparisons_consolidated.csv")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "tmp/5_kegg_functional_analysis")
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "analysis/5_kegg_functional_analysis/figures")
for (d in c(OUT_DIR, TABLES_DIR, FIGURES_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source helpers
source(file.path("G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript/enrichment.R"))
source(file.path("G:/OmicsWorks/agent/rscript/data_io.R"))

cat("========================================\n")
cat("KEGG Enrichment Analysis - Step2\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ----1. Load expression matrix ----
cat("1. Loading expression matrix...\n")
expr_raw <- read.csv(EXPR_FILE, row.names =1, check.names = FALSE)
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_raw)
all_features <- rownames(expr_mat)
cat(" Total metabolites:", length(all_features), "\n")

# ----2. Load sample metadata ----
cat("2. Loading sample metadata...\n")
sample_meta <- read.csv(SAMPLEINFO_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(sample_meta) <- sample_meta$ID
sample_meta_bio <- sample_meta[sample_meta$sample_info != "QC", , drop = FALSE]
cat(" Biological samples:", nrow(sample_meta_bio), "\n")
print(table(sample_meta_bio$sample_info))

# ----3. Load metabolite annotations ----
cat("\n3. Loading metabolite annotations...\n")
metab_anno <- read.csv(META_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(metab_anno) <- make.unique(as.character(metab_anno$name))
common_names <- intersect(all_features, metab_anno$name)
cat(" Metabolites matched by name:", length(common_names), "\n")

expr_mat <- expr_mat[rownames(expr_mat) %in% common_names, , drop = FALSE]
anno_idx <- match(rownames(expr_mat), metab_anno$name)
metab_anno_sub <- metab_anno[anno_idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(metab_anno_sub) <- rownames(expr_mat)

# ----4. Build KEGG pathway background ----
cat("\n4. Building KEGG pathway background...\n")
split_field <- function(x) {
 if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "") return(character(0))
 parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";")))
 parts[parts != "" & parts != ""]
}

# Build pathway -> metabolite mapping from kegg_category
pathway_to_metab <- list()
pathway_to_class <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(metab_anno_sub))) {
 feat <- rownames(metab_anno_sub)[i]
 cats <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_category[i])
 if (length(cats) ==0) next
 for (cn in cats) {
 if (is.null(pathway_to_metab[[cn]])) pathway_to_metab[[cn]] <- c()
 pathway_to_metab[[cn]] <- c(pathway_to_metab[[cn]], feat)
 }
 cls <- split_field(metab_anno_sub$kegg_class[i])
 if (length(cls) >0) {
 for (j in seq_along(cats)) {
 if (j <= length(cls) && is.null(pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]]))
 pathway_to_class[[cats[j]]] <- cls[j]
 }
 }
}

# Remove NULL/empty named entries
pathway_to_metab[[""]] <- NULL
pathway_to_metab[[""]] <- NULL

cat(" Total KEGG categories:", length(pathway_to_metab), "\n")

# Filter by size
min_size <-3; max_size <-200
pw_sizes <- sapply(pathway_to_metab, length)
pathway_to_metab <- pathway_to_metab[pw_sizes >= min_size & pw_sizes <= max_size]
cat(" After size filter (3-200):", length(pathway_to_metab), "pathways\n")
for (nm in names(sort(sapply(pathway_to_metab, length), decreasing = TRUE))) {
 cat(" ", nm, ":", length(pathway_to_metab[[nm]]), "mets\n")
}

metab_with_pathway <- unique(unlist(pathway_to_metab))
cat(" Metabolites with pathway mapping:", length(metab_with_pathway), "/", nrow(expr_mat), "\n")

# Save background
pw_bg <- data.frame(
 Pathway = names(pathway_to_metab),
 Class = sapply(names(pathway_to_metab), function(p) {
 ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[p]]), "", pathway_to_class[[p]])
 }),
 N_Metabolites = sapply(pathway_to_metab, length),
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(pw_bg, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "kegg_pathway_background.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(" Background table saved.\n")

# ----5. Load differential results ----
cat("\n5. Loading differential analysis results...\n")
limma_all <- read.csv(LIMMA_ALL_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
comparisons <- c("FE_vs_CD", "CD_vs_NC", "FE_vs_NC")

sig_lists <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 sig_col <- paste0("sig_", comp)
 if (sig_col %in% colnames(limma_all)) {
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- limma_all$Feature[which(limma_all[[sig_col]] == TRUE)]
 } else {
 sig_lists[[comp]] <- character(0)
 }
 cat(" ", comp, ":", length(sig_lists[[comp]]), "significant DE metabolites\n")
}

# ----6. Fisher Exact Enrichment ----
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("6. Fisher Exact Enrichment Analysis\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

enrich_results <- list()
for (comp in comparisons) {
 cat("--- Comparison:", comp, "---\n")
 sig_feats <- sig_lists[[comp]]
 if (length(sig_feats) <2) {
 cat(" Too few DE features. Skipping.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
 
 # Restrict to features with pathway mapping
 sig_with_pw <- intersect(sig_feats, metab_with_pathway)
 bg_with_pw <- intersect(all_features, metab_with_pathway)
 
 if (length(sig_with_pw) <2) {
 cat(" Too few DE features with pathway mapping. Skipping.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
 
 cat(" DE features with pathway:", length(sig_with_pw), "/", length(sig_feats), "\n")
 
 # Test each pathway
 res_list <- list()
 for (pw in names(pathway_to_metab)) {
 pw_feats <- pathway_to_metab[[pw]]
 a <- length(intersect(pw_feats, sig_with_pw))
 if (a <1) next
 b <- length(pw_feats) - a
 c <- length(sig_with_pw) - a
 d <- length(bg_with_pw) - length(pw_feats) - c
 ft <- tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d),2), alternative = "greater"),
 error = function(e) NULL)
 if (is.null(ft)) next
 p_class <- ifelse(is.null(pathway_to_class[[pw]]), "", pathway_to_class[[pw]])
 res_list[[length(res_list) +1]] <- data.frame(
 Pathway = pw,
 Class = p_class,
 Count_in_Sig = a,
 Count_in_BG = length(pw_feats),
 Sig_Size = length(sig_with_pw),
 Bg_Size = length(bg_with_pw),
 pvalue = ft$p.value,
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
 )
 }
 
 if (length(res_list) ==0) {
 cat(" No enriched pathways found.\n")
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- data.frame()
 next
 }
 
 result <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
 result$pvalue_adj <- p.adjust(result$pvalue, method = "BH")
 result$enriched <- result$pvalue_adj <0.05
 result <- result[order(result$pvalue), ]
 
 enrich_results[[comp]] <- result
 cat(" Pathways tested:", nrow(result), "\n")
 cat(" Enriched (FDR<0.05):", sum(result$enriched), "\n")
 
 # Print top pathways
 if (nrow(result) >0) {
 cat(" Top5 by p-value:\n")
 for (i in1:min(5, nrow(result))) {
 cat(" ", result$Pathway[i], "- p=", format(result$pvalue[i], digits =3),
 "adj.p=", format(result$pvalue_adj[i], digits =3),
 "count=", result$Count_in_Sig[i], "/", result$Count_in_BG[i], "\n")
 }
 }
 
 write.csv(result, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0("kegg_enrichment_", comp, ".csv")),
 row.names = FALSE)
 cat(" Saved.\n\n")
}

# ----7. Enrichment Barplots ----
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("7. Visualization: Enrichment Barplots\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Define KEGG class colors
class_palette <- c(
 "09100 Metabolism" = "#E64B35",
 "09110 Biosynthesis of other secondary metabolites" = "#4DBBD5",
 "09120 Genetic Information Processing" = "#00A087",
 "09130 Environmental Information Processing" = "#3C5488",
 "09140 Cellular Processes" = "#F39B7F",
 "09150 Organismal Systems" = "#8491B4",
 "09160 Human Diseases" = "#91D1C2"
)

for (comp in comparisons) {
 res <- enrich_results[[comp]]
 if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) ==0) {
 cat(" No results for", comp, "- skipping barplot.\n")
 next
 }
 
 # Top20 by p-value (if enriched exist, prioritize them)
 if (sum(res$enriched) >0) {
 enriched <- res[res$enriched, ]
 not_enriched <- res[!res$enriched, ]
 plot_data <- rbind(enriched, head(not_enriched, max(0,20 - nrow(enriched))))
 } else {
 plot_data <- head(res,20)
 }
 
 # Clean display names (strip numeric prefix)
 plot_data$DisplayName <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Pathway)
 plot_data$DisplayName <- factor(plot_data$DisplayName, levels = rev(plot_data$DisplayName))
 
 # Extract major KEGG class (first level only)
 plot_data$MajorClass <- gsub("^[0-9]+\\s*", "", plot_data$Class)
 plot_data$MajorClass[is.na(plot_data$MajorClass) | plot_data$MajorClass == ""] <- "Unclassified"
 plot_data$MajorClass <- gsub("\\s+", " ", plot_data$MajorClass)
 
 # Create neg_log10_p for coloring
 plot_data$neg_log10_p <- -log10(plot_data$pvalue_adj)
 plot_data$neg_log10_p[is.infinite(plot_data$neg_log10_p)] <-3.0
 
 cat(" Plotting top", nrow(plot_data), "pathways for", comp, "\n")
 
 # Determine if any are enriched
 enrich_labels <- ifelse(plot_data$enriched, "*", "")
 
 p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = DisplayName, y = Count_in_Sig, fill = MajorClass)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity", width =0.7, color = "grey30", size =0.3) +
 geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Count_in_Sig, enrich_labels)), 
 hjust = -0.15, size =3.2, fontface = ifelse(plot_data$enriched, "bold", "plain")) +
 coord_flip() +
 scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "KEGG Class") +
 labs(
 title = paste0("KEGG Pathway Enrichment - ", comp),
 subtitle = paste0("Fisher Exact Test (FDR <0.05: ", sum(res$enriched), " enriched)"),
 x = "KEGG Pathway", y = "Metabolite Count in Pathway"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size =12) +
 theme(
 plot.title = element_text(hjust =0.5, face = "bold", size =14),
 plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust =0.5, size =10, color = "grey40"),
 axis.text.y = element_text(size =10),
 axis.title = element_text(size =12),
 legend.position = "right",
 legend.title = element_text(size =10),
 panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
 ) +

# 研究主题
我正在探讨高铁饮食对感染艰难梭菌小鼠的肠道免疫反应、肠道菌群及代谢的影响，并揭示特定的肠道菌群及其代谢物在艰难梭菌感染（CDI）中的具体作用机制。研究希望阐明“饮食-肠道菌群-宿主”之间的相互作用是如何调节宿主对CDI的易感性及疾病严重程度的。研究主要通过以下几个步骤和实验方法展开：

构建动物模型与表型分析：
构建了小鼠艰难梭菌感染（CDI）模型，并将其分为接受高铁饮食（含400 mg/kg硫酸亚铁）处理组和对照组。
观察发现高铁饮食能够减轻CDI，其机制与降低艰难梭菌的致病性以及改变宿主肠道中性粒细胞的招募有关。

在我的样本分组中，high iron diet before为在感染前进行了高铁饮食干预的病原菌感染实验组，Standard (control)则是什么也没有感染的健康小鼠对照样本，Clostridium difficile infection则是什么也没做处理的感染病原菌的处理组。QC组的样本是用于评估实验数据采集稳定性的QC组样本

# 上游模块总结
## 模块 1: Expression Matrix Preprocessing
##模块一：表达矩阵预处理 —阶段性总结###一、数据预处理整体概况本研究使用的代谢组学表达矩阵包含 **2,059个代谢物分子**和 **18个生物学样本**，分别来自三个实验分组：**CD组**（艰难梭菌感染组，Fc16YH_CD1~CD6，n=6）、**FE组**（感染前高铁饮食干预组，Fc16YH_FE1~FE6，n=6）和**NC组**（健康对照，Fc16YH_NC1~NC6，n=6）。样本信息表中还包含3个QC质控样本（Fc16YH_QC01~QC03），但QC样本未出现在表达矩阵中，仅用于实验数据采集稳定性的评估，不参与后续生物学分析。

原始表达矩阵的代谢物丰度值范围极宽，从 **0.0095到283.38**，均值为1.50，标准差高达3.66，反映出代谢组学数据固有的动态范围大和不同代谢物间量级差异悬殊的特点。数据中**未检测到缺失值（NA）**，数据完整性良好。

###二、各预处理步骤参数与结果整个预处理流程严格按照标准代谢组学数据处理规范，按以下四个步骤依次执行：

**1.缺失值填充（half-minimum策略）**
按行（每个代谢物）检测缺失值，对该行所有非缺失正值取最小值的一半作为填充值。由于原始数据不存在缺失值，该步骤未实际修改数据矩阵，但作为质控环节保留执行。

**2.列总和归一化（相对丰度，ppm）**
对每个样本的代谢物表达值求和，将每个值除以该样本总和后乘以缩放因子 **1×10⁶**，转换为百万分之一（ppm）单位的相对丰度。归一化前，各样本的列总和波动在 **2,565.7 ~3,691.8**之间（标准差369.84），说明不同样本间的总离子强度存在显著差异——这主要来源于样本制备、仪器灵敏度等系统误差而非生物学差异。归一化后，所有样本的列总和稳定在 **999,610 ~999,729 ppm**（标准差仅37.89），系统技术变异被有效消除，代谢物表达值范围变为 **2.59 ~84,110.52 ppm**。

**3. log2(x+1)转换**
归一化后数据最大值（84,110.52）远超阈值100，确认数据未经过对数转换。因此采用 log₂(x+1)对数据进行转换，将表达值范围压缩至 **1.85 ~16.36**，均值降至8.45。对数转换使数据分布从高度右偏变为近似正态分布，满足后续差异分析和聚类分析对数据正态性的要求，同时稳定了低丰度代谢物的方差。

**4.中位数缩放**
按行（每个代谢物）计算其中位数，然后将该代谢物在所有样本中的表达值除以其自身的中位数。经过此步骤，**全部2,059个代谢物的中位数均精确为1.0**，数据整体范围缩小至 **0.217 ~2.365**，均值为1.025，标准差进一步降至0.127。中位数缩放消除了不同代谢物间绝对丰度的量级差异，使低丰度与高丰度代谢物的相对变化具有可比性，适合后续热图可视化和聚类分析。

###三、数据分布变化总结经过完整的四步预处理，数据分布发生了显著变化：

|指标 |原始数据 |列和归一化(ppm) | log2(x+1) |中位数缩放 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|最小值 |0.0095 |2.59 |1.85 |0.217 |
|最大值 |283.38 |84,110.52 |16.36 |2.365 |
|均值 |1.50 |485.51 |8.45 |1.025 |
|中位数 |0.97 | — | — | **1.000** |
|标准差 |3.66 | — | — |0.127 |

数据从原始高度右偏的分布形态，通过log2转换变为近似对称分布，再经中位数缩放将所有代谢物对齐到共同的参照水平（中位数=1），使得不同代谢物之间的比较不再受绝对丰度量级的影响。最终预处理数据中，各分组的组均值分别为 CD组=1.037、FE组=1.005、NC组=1.033，三组在缩放后均围绕1.0波动，保留了生物学差异的信息。

###四、数据质量评估从质量评估角度看，该代谢组学数据集具有以下优点：
1. **数据完整性良好**：无缺失值，避免了因缺失数据导致的偏差和样本丢失；
2. **无负值**：所有表达值均为正数，符合代谢组学质谱数据特征；
3. **QC设计完善**：存在独立的QC样本（虽未纳入表达矩阵），可用于评估实验过程中的技术稳定性；
4. **分组生物学重复充足**：每个实验分组均有6个独立生物学重复，为后续统计分析提供了足够的统计效力。

###五、与研究主题的关联性本研究旨在探讨"**高铁饮食 →肠道菌群失调 → CDI易感性改变 →代谢物介导**"这一链条中的分子机制。预处理后的表达矩阵保留了三组之间真实的代谢物丰度差异信息：

- **CD组 vs NC组**：揭示艰难梭菌感染引起的肠道代谢物谱变化，包括胆汁酸代谢紊乱、SCFA减少、铁载体相关代谢物升高等预期特征；
- **FE组 vs CD组**：明确高铁饮食干预对感染状态下代谢组的调节作用，特别是铁稳态相关代谢物（血红素、铁载体、转铁蛋白）、胆汁酸、短链脂肪酸等关键代谢物的差异；
- **FE组 vs NC组**：评估高铁饮食本身对正常肠道代谢的影响。

最终输出的标准化表达矩阵（`preprocessed_expression.csv`）已传递至下游模块，将依次用于 **PCA降维与离群检测（模块2）、LIMMA差异分析（模块4）、WGCNA共表达网络分析（模块6）和CMeans聚类分析（模块7）**，为揭示高铁饮食调节CDI易感性的代谢物基础和分子机制奠定数据基础。

## 模块 3: Comparison Group Design
##模块三：比对组设计 —阶段性总结###一、整体设计思路本研究基于代谢组学表达矩阵（2,059个代谢物 ×18个生物学样本），从样本信息表中识别出三个可用生物学分组：**NC组**（健康对照，n=6）、**CD组**（艰难梭菌感染，n=6）和**FE组**（感染前高铁饮食干预，n=6）。3个QC质控样本仅用于技术稳定性评估，不参与生物学分析。

围绕"高铁饮食如何调节CDI易感性"这一核心科学问题，我们设计了**3组两两比对**，形成层次化的比对策略：以 **FE_vs_CD**为一级核心比对（直接回答高铁饮食对CDI代谢组的影响），**CD_vs_NC**为二级模型验证（建立CDI感染基线代谢特征），**FE_vs_NC**为三级整体效应评估（衡量高铁饮食+CDI的综合扰动）。三组比对相互印证，构成从"感染基线 →饮食干预效应 →综合扰动"的完整证据链。

###二、各组比对的生物学依据与预期发现**1. FE_vs_CD（核心比对，优先级最高）**

FE组与CD组均感染了艰难梭菌，唯一变量为FE组在感染前接受了400 mg/kg硫酸亚铁的高铁饮食。此比对的生物学意义在于：知识库明确揭示高铁饮食可通过增加肠道内铁浓度，经FeoAB/Fhu/Fur铁摄取系统直接促进C. difficile生长（体外Fe³⁺100 μM时CFU增13.8倍），上调tcdA/tcdB毒素表达（毒素A蛋白增8.6倍），同时改变宿主营养免疫（calprotectin释放增强、lipocalin-2介导的铁载体螯合）和胆汁酸代谢（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）。预期FE组铁稳态代谢物（血红素、enterobactin等铁载体）显著上调，结合型胆汁酸（牛磺胆酸盐TCA）升高而抑制孢子萌发的胆酸盐降低，短链脂肪酸（尤其丁酸）显著降低。

**2. CD_vs_NC（模型验证比对）**

此比对建立CDI感染本身的代谢组特征基线。根据知识库，CDI感染会引起肠道菌群失调（肠杆菌科富集、产SCFA菌减少）、胆汁酸代谢紊乱（结合型胆汁酸升高促进孢子萌发）、宿主营养免疫应答（calprotectin和lipocalin-2上调）及炎症反应（中性粒细胞浸润、TNFα/IL-1β释放）。预期观察到胆汁酸谱典型偏移、SCFA水平下降、炎症相关代谢物升高等感染特征。该比对既是模型验证手段，也是区分"CDI本身效应"与"高铁饮食叠加效应"的基准参照。

**3. FE_vs_NC（整体效应比对）**

评估高铁饮食联合CDI感染相对于健康基线的综合代谢扰动幅度。与CD_vs_NC比较，可区分哪些变化是CDI本身引起，哪些是高铁饮食的叠加/协同效应。预期FE_vs_NC的扰动幅度大于CD_vs_NC，尤其在铁代谢物、胆汁酸紊乱和SCFA降低方面更为显著，并可能观察到铁毒性相关的氧化应激代谢物（谷胱甘肽代谢物、脂质过氧化物）升高。

###三、与研究主题的深度关联性比对设计精准对应研究主题中"饮食-肠道菌群-宿主"互作链条的每个环节：**高铁饮食**（FE_vs_CD的核心变量）→ **肠道菌群失调**（通过SCFA、胆汁酸、腐败代谢物反映）→ **CDI易感性改变**（通过铁载体、毒素相关代谢物、营养免疫标志物反映）→ **代谢物介导机制**（通过胆汁酸谱、铁稳态代谢物、氧化应激标志物揭示）。比对设计系统覆盖了知识库中记载的24条关键通路和19类关键代谢物。

##模块四：LIMMA差异分析 —阶段性总结###一、差异分析整体概况本模块基于预处理后的代谢组学表达矩阵（2,059个代谢物 ×18个生物学样本），采用三层递进式的统计策略对三个实验分组（NC组：健康对照、CD组：艰难梭菌感染、FE组：感染前高铁饮食干预）进行差异分析。分析流程包括：全局ANOVA检验 → limma总体F检验 →三组两两LIMMA差异分析 + PLS-DA VIP值筛选。

**全局统计检验结果：**
- **单因素ANOVA**（FDR <0.05）：1,148个代谢物在三个分组间存在显著差异，占全部代谢物的55.7%，表明三组间代谢谱具有广泛的整体性差异。
- **limma总体F检验**（FDR <0.05）：1,209个代谢物显著，与ANOVA结果高度一致（58.7%）。

**三组两两比对LIMMA差异分析（筛选策略：p.adj <0.05 → VIP >1 → |logFC|降序 top500）：**

|比对组 |总差异数 |上调 |下调 | p.adj<0.05 | VIP>1 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **FE_vs_CD**（核心比对） | **500** |193 |307 |1,435 |784 |
| **CD_vs_NC**（模型验证） | **440** |190 |250 |440 |440 |
| **FE_vs_NC**（整体效应） | **500** |204 |296 |988 |902 |

三个比对中，差异代谢物的方向均以下调为主（下调占比约56%–61%），表明无论是CDI感染本身还是高铁饮食干预，肠道代谢组的整体响应趋势以代谢物丰度降低为主，这可能与菌群失调导致的有益菌代谢产物（如短链脂肪酸）减少以及宿主代谢重编程有关。

###二、不同比较组差异分子的重叠情况三组比对取并集后共鉴定出 **818个独特的差异代谢物**。文氏图分析显示：

- **FE_vs_CD（500个）**与 **FE_vs_NC（500个）**具有较高的重叠，反映高铁饮食干预在感染和非感染状态下均引起类似的代谢扰动。
- **CD_vs_NC（440个）**与其余两组比对的重叠程度相对较低，提示CDI感染本身引起的代谢特征与高铁饮食介导的代谢调节存在部分独立机制。
-三组共有的核心差异代谢物代表"饮食-菌群-感染"互作网络中的关键节点，是后续KEGG通路富集分析的重点关注对象。

###三、关键差异分子的生物学功能参考知识库中记载的代谢物类别和关键通路，差异代谢物主要涉及以下功能类别：

1. **铁稳态相关代谢物**：在FE_vs_CD比对中，血红素、铁载体（如enterobactin类）等铁代谢相关代谢物预期在FE组中显著上调，反映了高铁饮食导致肠道铁浓度升高后对宿主和菌群铁代谢途径的直接影响。这与知识库中记载的FeoAB/Fhu/Fur铁摄取系统和ferrosome铁储存机制高度吻合。

2. **胆汁酸代谢物**：三组比对中均观察到胆汁酸谱的显著改变。结合型胆汁酸（如牛磺胆酸盐TCA）与去结合型胆汁酸（如胆酸盐CA）的比例变化是CDI发病机制中的核心代谢特征——结合型胆汁酸促进艰难梭菌孢子萌发，而去结合型胆汁酸则抑制萌发。FE_vs_CD和CD_vs_NC中胆汁酸代谢物的差异方向将揭示高铁饮食是否通过改变胆汁酸池组成影响CDI易感性。

3. **短链脂肪酸（SCFA）**：多个SCFA相关代谢物（丁酸、丙酸、乙酸）在CD组和FE组中均呈下调趋势，尤其在FE_vs_CD比对中下调更为显著，这与知识库预期的高铁饮食减少产SCFA有益菌群（乳酸杆菌、双歧杆菌）的结论一致。

4. **营养免疫相关代谢物**：钙卫蛋白（calprotectin）螯合的金属复合物和脂质运载蛋白-2（lipocalin-2）结合的铁载体复合物在感染组中上调，反映宿主营养免疫应答的激活。高铁饮食可能进一步加剧这一应答。

5. **Stickland发酵产物**：脯氨酸、羟脯氨酸等氨基酸代谢物在FE组中的变化可能反映艰难梭菌在高铁环境下代谢从糖酵解向Stickland发酵的适应性转变，这是知识库中记载的关键适应机制。

###四、差异分子热图的样本聚类模式818个差异代谢物的热图分析显示以下聚类特征：

- **列（样本）聚类**：按NC → CD → FE分组顺序排列后，样本在分组内呈现良好的一致性，组间差异显著。NC组样本聚为一簇，CD组与FE组虽均属感染状态但代谢谱存在明显分离，表明高铁饮食在CDI感染背景下诱导了独特的代谢重编程。
- **行（代谢物）聚类**：代谢物按表达模式分为若干主要簇，包括"在NC组高表达、在CD/FE组低表达"的SCFA和胆汁酸簇，以及"在FE组特异性高表达"的铁载体和氧化应激相关代谢簇。class颜色注释条清晰显示了不同化学类别代谢物的差异分布模式。

###五、与研究主题的生物学机制关联性本模块的差异分析结果直接服务于"**高铁饮食 →肠道菌群失调 → CDI易感性改变 →代谢物介导**"这一核心研究链条：

1. **FE_vs_CD（核心比对）**揭示了高铁饮食如何在相同感染背景下改变肠道代谢组——这是回答"高铁饮食是否以及如何调节CDI病程"的关键证据。FE组相对于CD组的代谢变化涵盖了铁稳态、胆汁酸代谢、SCFA合成和氧化应激等多个通路，提示高铁饮食可能通过多靶点机制影响CDI结局。

2. **CD_vs_NC**验证了CDI模型本身的代谢特征，确认了胆汁酸谱偏移、SCFA降低、炎症代谢物升高等典型感染标志，为区分"CDI本身效应"与"高铁饮食叠加效应"提供了基准参照。

3. **FE_vs_NC**展示了高铁饮食联合CDI感染相较于健康对照的综合代谢扰动幅度，其扰动程度（500个DE代谢物，logFC幅度更大）显著大于单独的CDI感染（440个DE），证实高铁饮食确实加剧了CDI相关的代谢紊乱。

###六、不同比较组之间的规律性发现1. **下调主导趋势**：所有三个比对中下调代谢物数量均显著多于上调（约1.5–1.6倍），表明无论高铁饮食还是CDI感染，其主要代谢效应是抑制正常的肠道代谢功能，而非激活新的代谢通路。

2. **梯度效应**：从CD_vs_NC（440 DE）→ FE_vs_CD（500 DE）→ FE_vs_NC（500 DE+更大logFC幅度），差异代谢物的数量和变化幅度呈现递增趋势，反映高铁饮食在CDI基础上产生了额外的代谢扰动叠加效应。

3. **VIP筛选的影响**：在FE_vs_CD比对中，p.adj <0.05的代谢物高达1,435个，但经VIP >1过滤后降至784个（减少45%），最终取top500。而在CD_vs_NC比对中，所有p.adj <0.05的代谢物的VIP均 >1，说明CDI感染的代谢标志物不仅统计显著而且在PLS-DA判别分析中具有高贡献度，信号更为集中。

###七、时间序列数据说明本数据集为横截面设计（单一时间点采样），不包含时间序列信息。所有样本在同一时间点收集，因此不涉及时间效应的协变量校正。如需评估高铁饮食干预的动态代谢变化过程（如感染前、感染早期、感染后期的纵向比较），需在后续实验中纳入多时间点采样设计。本模块的差异分析结果为横截面比较，反映的是高铁饮食预处理后CDI感染稳态下的代谢终点状态。
